## 2. Form Starts

Exercise Objective: Develop proper stride length, stride frequency, and body position from a static start

## Procedure

1. Place one foot directly behind the designated start line
2. Place other foot 6 - 12 in. behind heel of front foot and 2 - 4 in. to the inside of front foot (-13)
3. The hand opposite to the front foot is placed just behind the start line (usually on fingertips)
4. The other arm is extended behind body with a bend at the elbow
5. Hips should be higher than shoulders
6. A slight forward lean is used, which can cause the shoulders to cross over the start line
7. Eyes should be focused 2 - 3 ft in front of the start line
